title: Worked Solution
text: To calculate $$P(I \text{ or } F)$$, apply the general addition rule $$P(I \text{ or } F) = P(I) + P(F) - P(I \text{ and } F)$$ to account for any overlap between the two route choices. Since Mark can only take one route and $$P(I \text{ and } F) = 0$$, the events are mutually exclusive, so adding $$0.44 + 0.56 - 0$$ results in 1.
